snapshot.scope_description: PostHog's docker-compose hobby deployment: capture, ingestion, replay, error tracking, logs, app tier, low-latency services and data platform.
omissions: Cloud-only components (personhog leader/writer/identity, usage-ingestion, property-defs-ai, kafka-init) and dev-only tools are not modeled.
Per-product Django apps, ClickHouse tables and individual Kafka topics are not modeled.
Only topics whose producer or consumer was read in compose, config or code are modeled as topic interfaces; other Kafka use goes to the broker.
